_comment: This is the JSON configuration file to run the INS Algorithms.

log._comment: Configuration of the Log File (Possible values: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL).

algorithm._comment: Select the INS algorithm to execute (Possible options are: Sensor Emulator, Free Integration, Loosely Coupled)

reference_position._comment: available forms are LLA (latitude,longitude,altitude), LLD (latitude,longitude,down) or ECEF (cartesian x,y,z)

reference_velocity._comment: available frames: navigation n (v_eb^n), body b (v_eb^b), ECEF e (v_eb^e)

reference_attitude._comment: available forms: rpy (Roll, Pitch, Yaw) or quat (quaternion). The attitude rotation is from navigation to body frame (RPY_n^b or quat_n^b).

attitude._comment0: Select the attitude state to perform the derivative computation. Available states are 'rpy', 'dcm' or 'quat'
attitude._comment1: Select the differentiation method. Available options are 'finite-difference' or 'relative-attitude'
attitude._comment2: Select the finite-difference algorithm. Available options are 'forward-two-point', 'central-two-point', 'forward-three-point', 'backward-three-point', 'central-five-point', 'optimal'

velocity._comment: Select the finite-difference algorithm. Available options are 'forward-two-point', 'central-two-point', 'forward-three-point', 'backward-three-point', 'central-five-point', 'optimal'

output._comment: select output folder (absolute path) to store the run. Set 'default' to store in default path runs/
